name: Town Quests
description: Four fetch quests between NPCs in different towns: a giver asks you to find a keepsake, a letter, a rare herb, or a luck charm held by an NPC in another town, then rewards you (Poke Doll, Rare Candy, Max Ether, Nugget). Custom key items, branching dialogue with a YES/NO accept, and MOD_ flags. No engine files touched, no maps edited.
